seo.title: Track a wagon by number: first search free | YukSaroy
seo.description: Wagon location by number in Uzbekistan: which station it is at, loaded or empty, and what time the data refers to. The first search is free, up to 20 numbers at once.

about.h2: How to find out where a wagon is
about.p1: Enter the wagon number and the page shows its last known location: which station it is at, whether it is loaded or empty, and what time the data refers to. Route history is not shown, only the current position.
about.p2: The number has 7 or 8 digits. A leading zero does not matter: 01234567 and 1234567 are the same wagon. You can enter up to 20 numbers at once, one per line or separated by commas.

how.s3: See the station, the state and the time.

gives.i1: The station name, or a note that no station was given.
gives.i2: The state: loaded, empty or unknown.
gives.i3: What time the data refers to.
gives.i4: When the answer was last refreshed.
gives.p: Reports are refreshed once or twice a day, so asking for the same wagon again and again gives nothing new: the answer will be the same. That is why looking at your own wagon again within 6 hours is free.

rail.p: This page shows the current location of any wagon regardless of direction: it is tied neither to imported cargo nor to customs paperwork. Search by number, the answer on one screen, across Uzbekistan.

who.i1: A forwarder: where the cargo is and when it arrives.
who.i2: A cargo owner: whether the wagon is free and due back.
who.i3: A terminal: how many wagons arrive today.

faqBlock.q1: Where do I get the wagon number?
faqBlock.a1: The number is painted on the side of the wagon and written in the shipping papers. It is 7 or 8 digits.
faqBlock.q2: How many wagons can I check at once?
faqBlock.a2: Up to 20. Each number counts as a separate search.
faqBlock.a3: Reports are refreshed once or twice a day. The answer shows what time the data refers to.
faqBlock.q4: The wagon was not found, what now?
faqBlock.a4: Check the number first. If the number is right, the wagon is not in the reports: it may be new or outside the country.
faqBlock.a5: No, only the last known location.
faqBlock.q6: Do I need to sign in?
faqBlock.a6: Yes. Free searches are counted per user, so a search is tied to an account. The sign-in code arrives in the Telegram bot.
faqBlock.q7: How much does a wagon search cost?
faqBlock.a7: The first search is free. Opening the same wagon again within 6 hours does not count either. After that you need a subscription, which opens unlimited search.

free.p: The first search is free for every account: you can check a number and see the answer without paying. Opening your own wagon again within 6 hours is free too. After that, unlimited search comes with a subscription.

words.p: People look for this page in different ways: track a wagon, wagon tracking by number, wagon location, where is my wagon, check a wagon by number, find the wagon station. It is all the same thing: you enter the number and see where the wagon is now.
